2608.28281.title: LoopArena: Benchmarking Models as Runtime Controllers for Loop Engineering
2608.28281.paper_summary: Loop Engineering is emerging as a practice for organizing development work around coding agents. Instead of writing each prompt by hand, practitioners design loops that monitor progress, assign work, run checks, and decide what the agent should do next. Even with a capable coding agent, a loop may trust a stale progress note, skip needed verification, spend its budget in the wrong direction, or stop before the task is safe to submit. Yet the final outcome of one end-to-end run cannot tell whether success or failure reflects the loop's guidance or the coding agent's ability to carry out the task. We introduce LoopArena, a benchmark for evaluating how well one model can guide a separate coding agent through a long-running task. The model under evaluation is the \textbf{Controller}: after each coding round, it receives a structured summary of the run and instructs a separate, fixed coding agent, the \textbf{Worker}, on what to do or verify next, or decides whether to stop. LoopArena evaluates this ability in three complementary settings that differ in execution scope and cost. Type I scores next-step Loop Contract selection through execution-validated questions without running the Worker at evaluation time. Type II executes repeated control over a selected slice of a full task, while Type III evaluates the paired full task from its original state. On full tasks, the best observed Strict Success Rate is \textbf{24.69\%}, leaving substantial room for improvement in long-horizon loop control. Across Controllers, the paired reduction in estimated inference cost averages \textbf{64.4\%}, and Type II produces a similar ordering under the main Core criterion (Spearman's \(ρ=\textbf{0.9747}\)). We release the benchmark data and evaluation code at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/LoopArena .
2608.28281.paper_summary_zh: Loop Engineering 正在成為圍繞編碼代理組織開發工作的實踐。<lb/>從手動編寫每個提示轉變為，實踐者設計監控進度、分配工作、進行檢查並決定代理接下來應該做什麼的循環。<lb/>即使有一個能幹的編碼代理，循環也可能信任過時的進度記錄、跳過必要的驗證、將預算花在錯誤的方向上，或在任務尚未安全提交之前停止。<lb/>然而，單次端到端運行的最終結果無法告訴我們成功或失敗是反映循環的指導還是編碼代理執行任務的能力。<lb/>我們介紹了 LoopArena，一個用於評估一個模型如何引導一個獨立編碼代理完成長期任務的基準。<lb/>被評估的模型是 \textbf{Controller}：在每個編碼回合後，它接收運行的結構化摘要，並指示一個獨立的固定編碼代理 \textbf{Worker} 接下來應該做什麼或驗證什麼，或者決定是否停止。<lb/>LoopArena 在三個互補的設置中評估這一能力，這些設置在執行範圍和成本上有所不同。<lb/>類型 I 通過執行驗證問題來評分下一步的 Loop Contract 選擇，而不在評估時運行 Worker。<lb/>類型 II 對選定的完整任務片段進行重複控制，而類型 III 則從其原始狀態評估配對的完整任務。<lb/>在完整任務中，觀察到的最佳嚴格成功率為 \textbf{24.69\%}，在長期循環控制中仍有相當大的改進空間。<lb/>在所有 Controllers 中，估計推理成本的配對減少平均為 \textbf{64.4\%}，而類型 II 在主要核心標準下產生了相似的排序（Spearman's \(ρ=\textbf{0.9747}\)）。<lb/>我們在 https://github.com/AMAP-ML/LoopArena 發佈基準數據和評估代碼。
